days.top_line: South Africa's shooting toll held at 38 with no arrests, the Trump-Xi trade truce and Ukraine's drone war both rolled on, and India's Supreme Court hears a challenge to the new UPI
Sunday was tense: UK police foiled a bomb plot near a base used in US strikes on Iran. Kohli passed 15,000 ODI runs, and Anthropic claimed major AI science breakthroughs.
